headword: {院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}

definitions.explanation: The practice of a hospital or clinic preparing and handing prescribed medicine to the patient on its own premises, rather than issuing a prescription to be filled at an outside pharmacy.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}だ。
{院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}なら、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}れる→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: With in-hospital dispensing, you can pick up your medicine on the spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{診療所|しんりょうじょ}→診療所：14205_shinryoujo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many small clinics still carry out in-hospital dispensing.

notes:
Refers to receiving your medicine directly at the hospital or clinic where you were seen, rather than at an external pharmacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to practice in-hospital dispensing
- {院内|いんない}{処方|しょほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: a hospital that dispenses in-house
